description: This file contains React hooks, utility functions, and methods for managing an embedded iframe component, including styling, event handling, and communication with parent window, specific to the embed core functionality of a booking or scheduling application.

methods.name: useEmbedTheme
methods.description: React hook to get and set the current embed theme, updates on URL change.

methods.name: useEmbedUiConfig
methods.description: React hook to access and update the UI configuration for the embed, maintaining consistency across components.

methods.name: useEmbedStyles
methods.description: React hook to get styles for a specific element in the embed UI.

methods.name: useEmbedNonStylesConfig
methods.description: React hook to get non-style configuration for a specific element.

methods.name: useIsBackgroundTransparent
methods.description: Hook to determine if the embed background is transparent.

methods.name: useBrandColors
methods.description: Hook to get branding colors from embed non-styles config.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Function to retrieve the embed namespace from store or window.

methods.name: getEmbedType
methods.description: Function to retrieve the embed type from store or URL.

methods.name: useIsEmbed
methods.description: Hook to determine if current context is an embed, with optional server-side rendering support.

methods.name: useEmbedType
methods.description: Hook to get the current embed type.

methods.name: makeBodyVisible
methods.description: Function to make the document body visible, used in embed page setup.

methods.name: showPageAsNonEmbed
methods.description: Reverses embed page styles to show as a normal page.

methods.name: connectPreloadedEmbed
methods.description: Function to apply configuration to a preloaded embed page and notify parent.

methods.name: getEmbedBookerState
methods.description: Function to determine the current state of the Booker based on internal states and query status.

methods.name: updateEmbedBookerState
methods.description: Function to synchronize BookerState with embed state, accessible outside React effects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the embed SDK, sets up event listeners, and manages embed page lifecycle.
